name: Yamaha YDS-1 / YDS-2 250
engine: 246 cc air-cooled two-stroke parallel twin, premix
intro: Yamaha's first sporting 250 twins. Very rare now, with parts shared in places with the later YDS-3.

B: It runs on premix. Mix the oil into the fuel at the ratio in the manual.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
